notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Addressed some feedback we got!


 Enemies in Archival Survival are now faster and more aggressively track the player, so it doesn't take so long for the game to get interesting.
 In The Demon of Sound and Soup, a rhythm indicator's been added to the bottom of the screen, so the beat is more clear.
 In Bijem'd, the wide Moai's been reworked to prevent soft locks.
 Added an alternate control scheme for We're Abaubaut to Crash: Spacebar for Fuwawa, Left Click for Mococo.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: Very small bug fix to the way enemies spawn in Archival Survival.
